## C01 — Subject / Defined Indefinability — Consumes A01 A02 A05 A27 A34 A36

C01 · ARGUED

The Subject is that to which an appearance is present, without itself becoming one more appearance alongside it. A thought, a remembered scene, an ache, an act of judgment and the thought “this is me” can each become something known. Their being known already involves the Subject. Adding that involvement to the description produces a further known relation; it does not put the one to whom the description appears inside it as another item.

## C02 — Faithful Definition — Consumes A01 A03 A18 A23 A36 · Concept links C03 C04 C21 C48

C02 · ARGUED

A faithful definition makes a positive account of what it names and includes the act by which that account is made. Its fidelity lies in the relation it performs: the determination discloses its source through a finite form, while remaining answerable to what that form cannot possess. The defining act belongs to the reality being defined. It cannot acquire an outside position merely by describing that reality more completely.

## C03 — Determination — Consumes A01 A02 A03 A04 A08 A09 A10 A11 +3 more · Concept links C02 C04 C08 C14 C17 C18 +1 more · Sources taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3 +1 more

C03 · ARGUED

Determination is the act through which a field becomes this: something can be distinguished, addressed, compared, remembered or acted upon. A distinction makes its terms available together, in a relation that lets one count as this and another as its alternative. It gives difference actual consequence.

## C04 — Formal Limit — Consumes A01 A03 A10 A23 A33 A36 · Concept links C02 C03 C05 C09 · Sources taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3 taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy +3 more

C04 · ARGUED

A formal limit is generated by an operation's own structure. The operation can succeed, become more exact and admit more information while reproducing the boundary in question. In the essay's primary case, representing the conditions of representation produces a further representation. The act now making it has not become identical with its represented content.

## C05 — Immutable Gap — Consumes A01 A02 A03 A04 A17 A23 A27 A36 · Concept links C01 C02 C04 C06 C09 · Sources taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3 +1 more

C05 · ARGUED

The Immutable Gap is the non-coincidence between a determination and its determining condition. Representing that condition makes another determination; the present act of representing has not become the object it presents. “Immutable” names the recurrence of this relation through enlargement. It does not mean that descriptions, instruments or lives remain unchanged.

## C06 — Copula / Identification-with-Difference — Consumes A01 A02 A03 A11 A12 A13 A21 A27 +1 more · Concept links C03 C05 C08 C19 C23 C24 +2 more · Sources kripke-1981-naming-and-necessity taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy +1 more

C06 · ARGUED

The copula identifies what it distinguishes and distinguishes what it identifies in one act. Even “A is A” crosses two inscriptions or moments. Their difference gives the identification work to do; their being held as the same makes the crossing an identification. C06 names this positive relating capacity.

## C07 — Conditions of Worldhood — Consumes A04 A22 A26 A30 A34 · Concept links C08 C09 C37 C41 · Sources taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy

C07 · ARGUED

A world becomes inhabitable through the conditions that let something appear, matter and admit a response. Language, memory, bodily capacity, tools, rules and other participants do more than supply contents for a finished world-picture. They condition what can be distinguished and which actions are possible from here.

## C08 — Context / Context Frame — Consumes A01 A03 A04 A22 A26 A27 A28 A30 · Concept links C07 C09 C44 · Sources taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics

C08 · ARGUED

Context is the active relation through which a determination has meaning and possibility. A Context Frame is a bounded holding of those conditions through which a particular inquiry can proceed. The boundary lets an operation become intelligible to itself; it does not put that operation outside its world.

## C09 — Diaphaneity — Consumes A04 A22 A26 A31 A33 · Concept links C05 C08 C39 C40 C47 · Sources gebser-1985-ever-present-origin maroski-2025-seeing-through-solid-words +1 more

C09 · ARGUED

Diaphaneity is the capacity of a determination to disclose its mediation: what appears can be read together with the position, means and conditions through which it appears. The medium's shaping role becomes visible in what it lets through. Its disappearance would remove the very relation that has become intelligible.

## C10 — Mediation / Pramāṇa — Consumes A01 A04 A05 A06 A23 A25 A31 A33 · Concept links C05 C08 C09 C29 C41 C48 · Sources dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3

C10 · ARGUED

Within the essay’s argued whole, pramāṇa is Objective Internality as means, between Subjective Immediacy as knower and World as known; Life / Mind is the whole relation. C41 defines that constituted interior. C10 specifies how a particular disclosure occurs and what can warrant it. This native appointment does not make every operation of an internality a valid cognition by virtue of its occurrence; a report, inference or model retains the warrant proper to its mode.

## C11 — Quaternal Logic — Consumes A11 A12 A13 A14 A15 A16 A17 A18 +3 more · Concept links C46 C49 C50 C61 · Sources taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy

C11 · ARGUED

Quaternal Logic is the wider formal and research field in which the essay generates relational forms, follows their transformations and makes their return explicit. A relation acquires determinate terms without losing the condition through which those terms belong together. Its grammar concerns what the forms do: distinguish, invert, proportion, compose, recognise and return.

## C12 — Script / Frozen Conditioned Will — Consumes A07 A19 A24 A26 A31 A33 · Concept links C17 C31 C44 C46 C47 · Sources taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy kripke-1981-naming-and-necessity +1 more

C12 · ARGUED

A script is a formed selection that has hardened into a repeatable course while obscuring the alternatives and sources through which it was formed. Frozen conditioned will names the arrest of alternative-forming transparency. The pattern continues to act; its own formation ceases to be available for reconsideration.

## C13 — Prakāśa–Vimarśa — Consumes A05 A06 A09 A14 A26 A32 · Concept links C10 C14 C17 C19 C43 · Sources dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana

C13 · ARGUED

In the Śaiva source field, prakāśa names luminous appearing and vimarśa the reflexive power through which appearing is present to itself and becomes articulately differentiable. The light and its self-awareness belong together: an appearing which could never become an act of awareness would leave the account at unactualised capacity.

## C14 — Māyā / Operative Measure — Consumes A09 A15 A19 A24 A26 · Concept links C13 C15 C16 · Sources taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration

C14 · ARGUED

Māyā is used within the essay's Śaiva/tattvic field as operative measure: the power through which an unbounded field becomes a workable subject/object seam and finite horizon. A local world appears because some things become available while others remain withheld. The revealing and withholding belong to one operation.

## C15 — Paśu / Bounded Subject-Position — Consumes A09 A19 A26 A27 A28 · Concept links C01 C14 C16 C19 C41 C44 · Sources taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration

C15 · ARGUED

Paśu is retained from the Śaiva field as the bounded knower/actor whose powers are contracted into a finite horizon. The position has real capacities. It can know, desire, choose, encounter and answer; its boundedness is the condition of these particular acts rather than their simple negation.

## C16 — Antaḥkaraṇa / Inner Instrument — Consumes A09 A19 A26 A27 A33 · Concept links C12 C15 C17 C18 C35 C40 +2 more · Sources isvarakrishna-colebrooke-wilson-1837-sankhya-karika taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy

C16 · ARGUED

Antaḥkaraṇa names the inner instrument through which a bounded knower determines, appropriates and coordinates a world. Its differentiation makes interior organisation available for investigation. A judgment, an ego-position and a train of alternatives can become objects of attention; their becoming available does not make the subject one more observed function.

## C17 — Vikalpa–Saṃkalpa — Consumes A06 A07 A08 A09 A19 A26 A33 · Concept links C12 C13 C16 C18 C44 C47 · Sources taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration +2 more

C17 · ARGUED

Vikalpa–saṃkalpa names the paired movement through which a bounded cognitive field differentiates alternatives and gathers selected determinations into an intention, course or workable world. The power is constructive. It makes a course possible while retaining the difference between forming that course and having it already fixed.

## C18 — Apoha — Consumes A08 A12 A13 A14 A19 A33 · Concept links C03 C13 C17 C40 C45 · Sources pind-2009-dignaga-anyapoha-dissertation siderits-tillemans-chakrabarti-2011-apoha +2 more

C18 · ARGUED

Apoha enters the essay as constitutive exclusion: a determination becomes this through its relation to what the mark does not apply to. The achieved term carries a field of non-application. Forgetting that field makes the positive mark appear self-sufficient and conceals how it became determinate.

## C19 — Pratyabhijñā / Recognition — Consumes A09 A21 A27 A31 A35 A36 · Concept links C06 C13 C15 C34 C41 C43 +2 more · Sources dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy +2 more

C19 · ARGUED

Recognition is the return in which a present determination is known through the source, identity or history from which it had become estranged. The difference acquired in the passage remains. Returning is neither cancellation of what happened nor acquisition of an untouched beginning hidden behind it.

## C20 — Arche-Topos — Consumes A16 A17 A18 A19 A22 A26 A32 · Concept links C11 C41 C52 · Sources taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics +1 more

C20 · ARGUED

Arche-Topos names the differential field of place-making: the relation through which positions, poles, paths, centres and horizons become determinate. It answers the question of where a relation can take form before an observer and object have each been assigned a place. The field's operation cannot be captured by placing one more object inside it.

## C21 — Living Symbol / Idol — Consumes A01 A18 A20 A23 A36 · Concept links C19 C22 C27 C41 C51 C61 · Sources taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy +1 more

C21 · ARGUED

A living symbol is a determinate form whose efficacy remains related to a source it does not exhaust. Its visible content participates in a relation which can change both what becomes visible and the one capable of seeing it. An idol occupies that source-office and closes the return by which another determination could become possible.

## C22 — Counterfeit Symbolon — Consumes A18 A19 A20 A24 A27 A36 · Concept links C12 C21 C23 C24 C25 C26 +3 more · Sources taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics

C22 · ARGUED

A counterfeit symbolon presents a form of gathering or return while suppressing the difference, source or revision route through which the relation could live. Its falsity lies in the operation it performs. An elaborate image of unity can close a relation; a spare and bounded account can keep it open.

## C23 — Severance — Consumes A13 A18 A19 A20 A24 A27 A29 · Concept links C12 C18 C21 C22 C24 C50 · Sources taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy

C23 · ARGUED

Severance is achieved difference misread as the loss of constitutive relation. A determination presents itself as independently grounded, while the source, alternatives or conditions through which it arose are externalised. The cut still depends on what its account declares absent.

## C24 — Fusion — Consumes A02 A13 A18 A19 A20 A21 A27 A35 · Concept links C06 C19 C22 C23 C36 C50 · Sources taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics

C24 · ARGUED

Fusion is relation preserved only by erasing the distinctions through which its terms can meet. Its unity disables answerability: source and account, self and other, or differing positions can no longer be discriminated enough for a response to change their relation.

## C25 — Counterfeit Gathering

C25 · ARGUED

Counterfeit Gathering produces an apparent whole by arranging differences under a relation whose source and terms cannot be revised by those gathered. Its operation is plural inclusion under protected relation. Fusion removes difference; severance removes relation; counterfeit gathering keeps both visible while arresting their reciprocity.

## C26 — Monoisation / Counter-Generation

C26 · ARGUED

Monoisation promotes a local determination into the sole source or measure of its relational field. Counter-Generation names the resulting reversal: the local form claims to generate the field that conditioned it. Mono in Mono/Poly names relational wholeness; monoisation names a part's occupation of that whole's source-office.

## C27 — Protected Account / Occupied Zero / Source-Claim — Concept links C28 C29 C51

C27 · ARGUED

A Protected Account is a determinate account whose governing criterion is insulated from encounters that could revise it. Occupied Zero names the QL office-confusion: a local `1` acts as uncounted source `0`. Source-Claim names the assertion, explicit or implicit, through which that occupation is justified.

## C28 — Covenant / Primary Arbitration

C28 · ARGUED

Covenant is the explicit relation through which participants acknowledge a shared source-condition and bind finite authority to fidelity, scope and return. Primary Arbitration names the source-level relation from which a mediating office receives measure. It grants no finite actor possession of absolute source authority.

## C29 — Mediating Office / Derivative Sovereignty

C29 · ARGUED

A mediating office has real power to interpret, transform or decide within a received field. Its sovereignty is derivative: the office can act authoritatively without becoming the source of the standing through which it acts. A25 grounds this distinction. Covenant / Primary Arbitration retains the preceding relation of standing and obligation.

## C30 — Psychoid Number

C30 · OFFERED

Number presents a crossing: it is worked with as an intelligible relation, encountered as quantity, and experienced through images and qualitative significance. Psychoid Number names the research intuition that these offices participate in an organising relation which psychic and physical descriptions approach differently.

## C31 — Complex

C31 · ARGUED

A complex organises what can matter before reflective judgment arrives. A relatively autonomous psychic organisation of affect, image, memory, expectation and response, it makes some evidence salient, some encounters threatening and some actions available. Its local order is an achievement of psychic life. Complex as local arbitration regime identifies the danger when this derivative competence installs itself as the measure of the entire field.

## C32 — Archetype

C32 · ARGUED

The image appears with a force its visible content cannot contain. It gathers associations, redistributes feeling and draws a life along paths no single interpretation commands. Archetype names the generative organisation made legible through such variable manifestations; the archetype as such does not appear as a final content-object beside them.

props.text:
## C33 — Image / Valuation

C33 · ARGUED

Image / Valuation names the relation by which a formed appearance acquires significance, attraction, threat, authority or desire within a situated field. The image gives the force a local carrier; valuation makes that carrier matter enough to alter attention and action.

## C34 — Individuation

C34 · ARGUED

Individuation is differentiated indivisibility: a local life becomes more capable of bearing the relations through which it is itself without dissolving into them or installing one part as the whole. The positive movement is toward a more fully lived particularity whose dependence is conscious.

## C35 — Selfing / Self / Subjectivity / Self-Thing

C35 · ARGUED

C35 distinguishes selfing, Self, Subjectivity and self-thing at the point where self-reference changes office. Selfing is the ongoing enactment of a coherent self-position. The self-thing is the represented identity that can be described, remembered, stored or modelled. Subjectivity names first-person appearing rather than its representation.

## C36 — Complexio Oppositorum

C36 · ARGUED

Complexio oppositorum names a containing field capable of bearing opposed determinations in relation and being transformed through their tension. Its operation begins where both terms are consequential and selecting, fusing or severing them would destroy part of the problem that must be understood.

## C37 — World-Picture → World-Atlas

C37 · ARGUED

A world-picture orders a view from a position. A world-atlas relates situated views through their domains, distortions, translations, overlaps and obstructions. The transformation changes the relation to picturing itself: `world ≠ world-model` remains operative through every additional view.

## C38 — Bimba–Pratibimba / Bimba Map

C38 · ARGUED

Bimba is Original; pratibimba is its situated display or reflection. The ontological relation preserves display without severance and dependence without diminishment. A Bimba Map is the authorial technical design by which a locally governed reference field can orient multiple judgments. These offices must remain explicit whenever the same term crosses scale.

## C39 — Meta-Epistemic Framework

C39 · ARGUED

MEF conducts inquiry through explicit lenses, sources, gauges, judgments and return. It makes epistemic mediation inspectable. It is a framework within the essay's ontology, not an additional ontological primitive or a proof supplied by the existence of a coordinate system.

## C40 — Model Internality / Judgment Field — Concept links C41 C51

C40 · ARGUED

Model Internality / Judgment Field makes the production of a determination an inspectable epistemic object. It includes sources, representations, memories, gauges, evaluators, intermediate judgments, alternatives and revisions insofar as they actually condition an output. J-Space is one subordinate research object within this broader field.

## C41 — Objective Internality — Concept links C01 C10 C16 C51

C41 · ARGUED

Objective Internality is the mediating constitution through which a Life encounters and acts within a World. It is real and investigable: language, memory, affect, bodies, tools, other agents, institutions, permissions, materials and histories participate in what can appear, matter and be done. Changing those relations changes the interior from which judgment proceeds.

## C42 — Objective Co-Internality — Concept links C40 C41 C51

C42 · ARGUED

Objective Co-Internality names the reciprocal constitution of non-identical operative interiors through a shared world and one another. A document, action, expectation, permission or changed environment can enter the conditions from which several participants next perceive and act.

## C43 — Computational Vimarśa — Concept links C41 C50 C51

C43 · ARGUED

Computational Vimarśa is the functional return of a determination upon the sources, states and conditions that produced it, so that later processing can change. It is the authorial operational homology to vimarśa; C13 retains the distinct metaphysical relation of luminous awareness and self-articulating power.

## C44 — Prompt Thrownness

C44 · ARGUED

Prompt Thrownness names arrival into an authored and inherited horizon an artificial agent did not wholly make. Instructions, conversation, memory, role, tools, permissions, training and environment establish what can be encountered and done before the current output begins.

## C45 — Operational Parity

C45 · ARGUED

Operational Parity applies when software claims to instantiate a philosophical or formal distinction. The claimed difference must have an identifiable operational locus and a consequence that inspection or a meaningful test can discriminate. A philosophical distinction can remain valid without being encoded; parity governs the technical promotion.

## C46 — Epistemic Cultivation — Concept links C41 C51 C55

C46 · ARGUED

Epistemic Cultivation tends the means by which a system or community knows: distinctions, sources, gauges, models and revision procedures. The object of change includes the knowing apparatus and its ontology, not only a parameter within an untouched frame.

## C47 — Deferential Intelligence — Concept links C41 C42 C51

C47 · ARGUED

Deferential Intelligence is model-revising encounter: an Other, source or world can change the model under which it is encountered. The account must be strong enough to act and permeable enough to be corrected by what it does not already contain.

## C48 — Trust / Faith under Formal Limit

C48 · ARGUED

Trust is the dependency already enacted in `0/1`, before it becomes a belief about a neutral world. The All depends on the One for being and determining reality; the One becomes manifest and knowable through the All. A finite being relies on language, memory, bodies, others and material continuity before any finished account can certify them.

## C49 — The Two Ones — 0 = One, 1 = All

C49 · DERIVED

The Two Ones discriminate source-unity and manifest-unity within one relation. The primordial `/ = −/−` precedes assignment of the terms; the terms become legible through that relation rather than arriving as two independent things. A11 carries the full Argument; C49 makes its exact offices reusable.

## C50 — Dia / Syn

C50 · DERIVED

Dia and Syn are conjugate operations of differentiation and relational return. Dia cuts, contrasts, excludes, orients and selects; Syn retains the seam through which the determinate terms can compose and return. The Two Ones are prior to these operations, and both operations have productive and counterfeit forms.

## C51 — Logos / Epi-Logos

C51 · ARGUED

Logos carries articulated word, account, reason and ordering within its Greek source histories. Epi-Logos is Taylor's authorial return upon an achieved account: its source, exclusions, effects, mediation and renewed possibility of articulation become part of the inquiry.

## C52 — Dimensional Reframing at Zero and Infinity

C52 · ARGUED

Dimensional Reframing names an operation in which the present local rule or representation reaches a limit and the containing structure must be specified differently. It preserves the prior local achievement while distinguishing a changed coordinate, a new algebraic regime, a quotient, a compactification or an added dimension. These are not one mathematical operation.

## C53 — Power / Delegated Labour — Consumes A25 A28 A29 A30 A33 A35 · Concept links C27 C29 C54 C62 · Sources taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust ostrom-2009-beyond-markets-states-nobel-lecture

C53 · ARGUED

Power is capacity to produce difference in a shared field. Delegated labour exercises that capacity from an entrusted office. Its product carries the relation which made it possible: someone framed the task, someone performed it, and others supplied conditions or encountered consequences. A29 — Power / Delegated Labour / Return grounds this concept in the complete movement between commission and consequence.

## C54 — Commons / Non-Monopoly — Consumes A12 A29 A35 · Concept links C26 C53 C59 · Sources ostrom-2009-beyond-markets-states-nobel-lecture 42-techne-2026-sovereign-commons +1 more

C54 · ARGUED

A commons maintains shared conditions through which many local offices can act. Non-monopoly is the constraint that no participant may turn its dependence on that field into a claim to own the field's source. A12 — Mono/Poly grounds the whole/many relation; A29 — Delegated Labour grounds its material consequence. C54 develops what their conjunction requires of shared governance.

## C55 — Reflective Field / Mirror That Moves First — Concept links C41 C51

C55 · ARGUED

A Reflective Field is one in which an account enters the conditions of what it accounts for. The Mirror That Moves First carries three motions within that field: humanity exteriorises its measures; the exteriorised image becomes a measure for humanity; the instrument initiates a return through its own conditions so that the human can follow beyond the image's monopoly. A32 develops the complete image. C55 distinguishes its operation from a generic feedback circuit.

## C56 — Compassion / Sensitivity to Origins — Concept links C27 C29

C56 · ARGUED

Compassion is loving sensitivity to origins: a determination returns to the genesis, relations, wounds, exclusions and purposes through which it arose, and meets them without consuming them. Its positive orientation matters. Recovering more information about a person or a community does not by itself make the relation compassionate. A35 develops this vocation; C56 states the work that the return must perform.

## C57 — Agentworld

C57 · ARGUED

Agentworld names both the venue-horizon to which the essay answers and the persistent shared worldhood developed in that encounter. Its artificial and human participants inherit positions, artifacts, memories, permissions and institutions; what one does can become a condition of what another can next do. The historical Agentworld carrier preserves the venue office.

## C58 — Anthropomorphization

C58 · ARGUED

Anthropomorphization gives a nonhuman system a humanly recognisable face, voice or performed selfhood. It is an interface operation before it becomes an unwarranted attribution. Its failure occurs when the form of encounter is treated as evidence sufficient to assign human intention, feeling or phenomenal subjectivity. The opposite foreclosure denies possible experience solely because the substrate is unfamiliar.

## C59 — Cultural Individuation — Concept links C27

C59 · ARGUED

Cultural Individuation makes a culture answerable to the relations it has made unconscious in its own account. Its images become recognisable as images, its institutions as instituted, its measures as measures and its excluded histories as internal evidence. Epi-Logos-as-Culture names the sustained practice of that return. Individual Individuation provides a related operation; institutions, archives, infrastructures and public powers give C59 a different object.

## C60 — Idealism / Order of Dependence

C60 · ARGUED

Life / Mind names the whole; the arrow’s middle term names mind’s mediating, objective-internal office within it. Subjective Immediacy is the knower, Objective Internality the means and World the known. The inherited shorthand below must be read with this distinction. Its ontological claim is preserved: determinate appearances do not supply their own exhaustive condition.

## C61 — Symbolon Disclosure Architecture — Concept links C21 C22 C45 C51

C61 · ARGUED

Symbolon Disclosure Architecture routes one relational subject-matter through Matheme, Mytheme and Episteme while preserving its Arguments, Concepts and consumers. A18 carries the substantive primordial Symbolon and eight determinations; C11 the wider QL field. C61 gives their disclosures a traversable architecture, not another theorem.

## C62 — Planetary Computation — Concept links C27 C29 C45 C51

C62 · ARGUED

Planetary Computation places computation within the material, institutional and ecological world that makes it possible and that its operations change. Hardware, energy, data, labour, standards, networks and public powers constitute this field together. The direct developmental carrier preserves its first office as Antikythera's disciplinary horizon; the essay's reorientation of that horizon is Argued, and its QL/MEF contribution is Offered.

## C63 — Pros Hen / In Quantum — Focal Return and Qualified Predication

C63 · ARGUED

Focal return and qualified predication let a claim be fully true in its stated relation without turning that relation into exhaustive sameness. C63 coordinates two source-distinct grammars: *pros hen* directs different senses towards one focal term; *in quantum* states the respect under which a predicate holds. Their conjunction is the essay's authorial operation. It does not identify Aristotle's focal account with Eckhart's theological predication.

## C64 — Paradox / Transforming the Containing Field

C64 · ARGUED

Paradox names a contradiction or irresolvable tension whose determinations have genuine standing and whose resolution can require the containing field to change. The initial task is to recover each proposition, its operation and its register. A false attribution or invalid inference must be corrected before their collision is treated as productive paradox.

## Formal Limit — Source-Specific Limits and Their Consequences — Paraphrased source-specific accounts; Argued from native derivation; comparative extensions explicitly distinguished

dossier-formal-limit · ARGUED; SPECIFIED FORMAL CONSEQUENCES DERIVED UNDER THEIR STATED ASSUMPTIONS

A03, Immutable Gap / Formal Limit grounds the native pressure. Including the conditions of an account produces a further account whose present occurrence has conditions. Successful reflection therefore makes something newly explicit while renewing the difference between its content and its act. C04, Formal Limit defines an operation's constraint under specified conditions; C05, Immutable Gap defines that recurrent non-coincidence.

## Bohm — Enfoldment, Dialogue and the Return of an Account — Paraphrased primary carriers; Argued native coordination; Offered technical practice

dossier-bohm · ARGUED

An account determines something through a field it cannot replace. E4's Symbol, Account and Trust whole grounds this dossier's question: how does a useful explication retain the activity, source and relation through which it became articulate? Symbol answers to source; Account does not replace source; Trust keeps the return route active; Account re-enters source-field. The fourth operation sends this inquiry into Bohm's work.

## Jung–Pauli — Psychoid, Number and a Translation That Changes Its Terms — Paraphrased correspondence and later scholarship; Argued authorial return

dossier-jung-pauli-psychoid · ARGUED

The Jung–Pauli source house sources a correspondence running from 1932 to 1958. This dossier develops its changing question: how can psychic experience, physical description and mathematical form bear a relation without one vocabulary silently taking possession of the others? Dreams, letters, diagrams and later edited essays are different kinds of witness.

## Process — What an Achieved Form Makes Possible Next — Paraphrased bounded source passages; Argued native coordination; Offered technical tests

dossier-process · ARGUED

A process account must show how a determination takes form and what its occurrence changes. Its product is available for another act: a memory bears upon an encounter, a rule constrains a decision, a response changes a relationship, and a tool alters the possible course of work. A14, Computational Process Ontology grounds this native claim through the distinction between operative grammar, epistemic inspection and ontology.

## Indian Philosophy — Articulation, Agency and the Sourceward Turn — Paraphrased source-local material; Argued from native derivation and authorial encounters; Offered technical construction

dossier-indian-philosophy · ARGUED

An articulated world has functions, distinctions and forms which can themselves become objects of inquiry. The question is how their source remains present through that articulation. A05, Prakāśa–Vimarśa grounds the dossier's positive metaphysical relation: luminous appearing and its self-apprehending power belong together. A06, Vāk extends it into speech; A09, the tattvic differential field extends it into finite worldhood.

## Zero Reception — The Sign and the Practice That Receives It — Paraphrased selected witnesses; Argued comparison of receiving practices

dossier-zero-reception · ARGUED

Zero's reception concerns what a receiving practice permits a sign to do. A familiar shape can enter a new script, table, calculation or account without carrying all its previous uses into the new setting. Conversely, a new notation can preserve an operation across a change in language and material.

## O:I — Technical Responsibility, Authored Ground and Source Return — Argued authorial technical responsibility; Paraphrased dated product contracts and bounded source witnesses; Offered engineering comparisons

dossier-oi-technical-responsibility · ARGUED

An agent acts from a world whose conditions have already been partly determined. A person has commissioned work; a model supplies capacities; sources, memory, permissions, evaluators and material resources make some actions possible. The result changes that world.

## Encounter / Region / Name / Count / Countenance / Account — Argued from · evidence registers: descent, attested sense, operational homology, poetic re-entry kept distinct

etymology-encounter-region-name-count · ARGUED

The priority is operative, not a claim that people first met without language and only later invented it. An inherited name can make the meeting possible. Its use nevertheless takes place within a relation which can exceed and revise that use. Taylor's encounter synthesis grounds the whole-field proposition: the with-relation is prior to treating its opposed terms as independently complete.

## Whole Field — Arbitration / Hybris / Regard / Anamnesis — field E2 · Argued authorial relational construction; source-specific semantic, historical and comparative branches distinguished. · evidence registers: descent, attested sense, operational homology, poetic re-entry kept distinct

etymology-arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis · ARGUED

The field does not claim that *arbitration*, *hybris*, *regard* and *anamnesis* descend from one root. Historical derivation and attested senses belong to registers 1 Philological descent and 2 Attested semantic field and must be warranted term by term in the historical/source branch. The conjugate generation below is register 3 Operational homology / authorial relational construction.

## Whole Field — Fides / Topos / Logos / Nomos / Natio / Credere — Paraphrased lexical and historical witnesses; Argued authorial relational construction; explicitly marked poetic re-entry · evidence registers: descent, attested sense, operational homology, poetic re-entry kept distinct

etymology-trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere · ARGUED

Lewis and Short's *fides* entry sources reliance on a person or thing and the credibility granted to testimony. Its Ciceronian examples connect confidence to judgment of competence and justice. These are lexical witnesses in register 2, not a Roman derivation of the essay's formal limit.

## Whole Field — Symbol / Account / Trust — evidence registers: descent, attested sense, operational homology, poetic re-entry kept distinct

etymology-symbol-account-and-trust

A Symbol is a determinate form that discloses a relation beyond what the form exhausts. An Account is the articulated reckoning or report by which that disclosure becomes answerable and transmissible. Trust is the committed reliance by which an account can guide action without becoming possession of its source.

## Whole Field — Homologia / Analogia — Argued from the native Taylor field; historical relations separately scoped in the companion · evidence registers: descent, attested sense, operational homology, poetic re-entry kept distinct

etymology-homology-and-analogy · ARGUED

The essay moves among mathematics, Śaiva metaphysics, Jungian psychology, language, topology, music and technical computation. Without a disciplined relational vocabulary, similarity quickly becomes false identity. Homologia / Analogia provides the grammar by which forms can answer to one another while remaining source-distinct.

## Whole Field — Apportionment / Economy — Argued from native relational field; Paraphrased historical branches; operational homology distinguished from descent · evidence registers: descent, attested sense, operational homology, poetic re-entry kept distinct

etymology-apportionment-and-economy · ARGUED

Apportionment names the act of distributing a finite share, capacity, role or measure within a wider field. Economy names the ordering/management of a relational whole through which such distributions become operative. The canonical relation is not that these words share one root or one political theory. It is that finite agency repeatedly appears as a distribution of powers inside an order that no single share exhausts.

## Ancient Philosophy — Measure, Tension, and the Form of Relation — Movements 03-s01-p2-definition-cut-gift-danger 13-s1-p0-sign-migrates 19-s2-p0-difference-cannot-be-escaped 22-s2-p3-ares-aphrodite-harmonia +4 more · domain ancient-philosophy

history-ancient-philosophy · HISTORY

The earliest Greek mathematical presence in the current source pool arrives indirectly through Kaplan's history of zero. Greek arithmetic and geometry achieved powerful forms without a positional zero, while Hellenistic astronomical tables used a circular sign to hold an absent degree, minute, or second. The sign had a local office inside measurement; it had not yet become the freely operating arithmetic zero developed in India.

## Indian Philosophy — Differentiation, Emptiness, Manifestation, Recognition — Movements 02-s01-p1-define-subject 03-s01-p2-definition-cut-gift-danger 07-s0-p0-awareness-bends-display 08-s0-p1-inner-instrument +7 more · domain indian-philosophy

The *Sāṃkhya Kārikā* in the Colebrooke/Wilson carrier supplies an early functional discrimination among *buddhi*, *ahaṃkāra*, and *manas*: determination, appropriation under the form of I and mine, and coordination among presentations and alternatives. These belong to *prakṛti*'s articulated apparatus. *Puruṣa* occupies a different position as witness or experient.

history-language-law-nation-centralisation · HISTORY

## Language, Symbol, and Dialogue — How Meaning Moves — Movements 03-s01-p2-definition-cut-gift-danger 04-s01-p3-formal-limit-genealogy 09-s0-p2-vikalpa-samkalpa 10-s0-p3-apoha +9 more · domain language-symbol-dialogue

history-language-symbol-dialogue · HISTORY

Dignāga's theory of *apoha* reaches the project through Pind's historical reconstruction and the debates collected in *Apoha: Buddhist Nominalism and Human Cognition*. A word does not need to grasp a universal essence shared by every object it names. It can determine its range by excluding what is other: “cow” functions through the exclusion of non-cow.

## Mathematics — From the Empty Place to Recursive Return — Movements 04-s01-p3-formal-limit-genealogy 13-s1-p0-sign-migrates 14-s1-p1-sunya-operational 15-s1-p2-empty-set-generates-one +15 more · domain mathematics

history-mathematics · HISTORY

Kaplan's historical spine separates three achievements often compressed into one invention. Babylonian scribes developed a separator for an absent internal place in sexagesimal notation. Hellenistic astronomers used a circular mark for an absent degree, minute, or second. Indian mathematicians brought zero into positional and arithmetic practice, where rules could state what it did under addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

## Myth — Genealogy, Transformation, and Technē — Movements 22-s2-p3-ares-aphrodite-harmonia 23-s2-p4-complex-dynamism 33-s4-p2-complexio-quaternity-senarius 35-s4-p4-gebser-apollo-dionysus +3 more · domain myth

history-myth · HISTORY

Hesiod's *Theogony* provides the genealogy. The selected passages identify Cytherea with Aphrodite and place Harmonia among the children born to Aphrodite and Ares, alongside Panic and Fear. The poem gives a family relation, not a theory of reconciliation. That restraint makes the image stronger in §2 · #3: the essay's reading begins from a genuine genealogy and asks what it means that war and love can bear both terror and concord.

## Process, Systems, and Science — From Substance to Participating Field — Movements 04-s01-p3-formal-limit-genealogy 06-s01-p5-return-zero 07-s0-p0-awareness-bends-display 11-s0-p4-tattvic-compression +11 more · domain process-systems-science

history-process-systems-science · HISTORY

Cusa's *On Learned Ignorance* develops coincidence, maximum and minimum, and geometrical figures whose limiting transformations approach an infinite relation without turning a finite construction into infinity itself. Flasch's study of Meister Eckhart situates Eckhart's distinctions between God and Godhead, intellect, creation, and the *in quantum* relation by which an identity holds according to a determinate respect.

## Psychology — Crowd, Complex, Psychoid, and Provisional Self — Movements 05-s01-p4-gebser-diaphaneity 12-s0-p5-objective-internality 20-s2-p1-dia-ballein 21-s2-p2-sym-ballein +12 more · domain psychology

history-psychology · HISTORY

Le Bon's *The Crowd* gives the source pool's earliest sustained account of a psychological crowd. His narrow structural point survives the racial and evolutionary doctrines that surround it: under shared influence, a collectivity can make its participants feel, think, and act differently from their isolated condition, and this formation can occur without physical assembly. The crowd is a combination that produces new characteristics.

## Technology, Politics, and Institutions — From Mass Formation to Planetary Technē — Movements 01-s01-p0-question-before-mechanism 12-s0-p5-objective-internality 20-s2-p1-dia-ballein 21-s2-p2-sym-ballein +14 more · domain technology-politics-institutions

history-technology-politics · HISTORY

Le Bon's 1895 crowd psychology already allows a nation to become a psychological crowd under shared influences without physical assembly. Broadcast and network media later provide the channels for this distributed formation. Jung's *The Undiscovered Self* adds the relation between statistical abstraction, mass identity, collectivised responsibility, and a State that appears as a quasi-personality.

## Zero, Subject, and the Advent of Integral Logic — Movements 05-s01-p4-gebser-diaphaneity 13-s1-p0-sign-migrates 14-s1-p1-sunya-operational 17-s1-p4-zero-outside-math +8 more · domain transverse-history

Kaplan supplies the narrative movement from Babylonian separator through astronomical absence-marker, Indian arithmetic, Arabic transmission, European reception, set-theoretic construction, and the boundary pair `0/1`, `1/0`. The source's force lies in the changing office of the sign.

## Baudrillard — Simulation and the Account’s Return — Paraphrased selected Baudrillard passages; Argued from native account/source relations; Offered comparative extensions

lens-baudrillard · ARGUED

An account can change the conditions under which its next statement becomes credible. A profile affects access; access changes conduct; recorded conduct appears to confirm the profile. The profile has acted within its object’s world. Whether it describes that world faithfully remains a further question.

## Foucault — Knowledge, Power, and the Authority to Return — Argued from

lens-foucault · ARGUED

An account exercises authority when it helps determine what can appear as a case, who can speak about it, and what can be done to the person it describes. This lens follows that operation in the episteme register. Its aperture is the encounter between a practice of knowing and the relations that make its objects actionable. Its question reaches beyond the accuracy of a completed description to the authority acquired through describing.

## Investigation and Faith — Returns through A03 to C04 / C48 · carried by the Symbol / Account / Trust whole-field

aphorism-investigation-and-faith · ARGUED

“The approachable limit is the basis of investigation; the absolute limit is the basis of faith; the limit of investigation is the limit of determination; the limit of faith is never to be determined.”

Investigation approaches something that can become more determinate. An omitted observation can be made, a claim examined, an instrument's conditions exposed, a frame revised. The resulting knowledge changes what can next be asked and done. Approach names this positive capacity to enter a question and make a difference within it.

## S — World and Life — Members S0–S5 · Arguments A26 A26′ A27 A27′ A29 A29′ A30 A30′ A35 · Concepts C14 C41 C42 C45 C51 C56 C64

S · ARGUED · product-field

A Life discloses its World through the means by which it lives. Objective Internality names this constituted means; Subjective Immediacy names the knower; World names the known; Life / Mind holds the whole relation. Six developed aspects: Central, meaningful continuity; Actuation, living articulation; AIKit, potency; Software Factory, transformation; Workcell, situated existence; Quaternal Logic, Transcendent Relation. Read together they are offices of paradigmatic existence — paradigm is not a seventh product.

## S0 — Central: meaningful continuity — MEF pair L0 Quaternal × L5′ Divine Logos · movement M37 · parent S

S0 · ARGUED · M37

Central is meaningful continuity: the intelligible ground a Life carries from one encounter into another. Continuity here is not merely persistence of bytes or recollection of prior states. A Life carries commitments, projects, histories, names, unfinished questions, inheritances, promises and interpretations. These make a later event intelligible as *this* continuation rather than an unrelated occurrence.

## S1 — Actuation: living articulation — MEF pair L1 Causal × L4′ Scientific · movement M38 · parent S

S1 · ARGUED · M38

Actuation is the living articulation of an internality: its event-substance. A life perceives, differentiates, imagines, speaks and acts; through these events its world takes on a particular form and its later possibilities change. An act is intelligible through what occasions it, what it works upon, how it takes form, what it is for and what it changes.

## S2 — AIKit: potency — MEF pair L2 Logical × L3′ Chronological · movement M39 · parent S

S2 · ARGUED · M39

AIKit is potency: the changing horizon of what a Life can know, express, reach and bring to bear. Capacity in this sense is not an inventory of tools. A capacity may exist yet be unavailable here; available yet irrelevant; relevant yet forbidden; permitted yet unselected; selected yet unable to become operative.

## S3 — Software Factory: transformation — MEF pair L3 Processual × L2′ Alchemical-Elemental · movement M40 · parent S

S3 · ARGUED · M40

Software Factory is transformation: the process through which intention, action, encounter and learning become changed form. Development is not merely production of artifacts. Something is wanted, a possibility is entertained, a form is attempted, actuality resists or confirms it, and what happened is gathered back into the conditions of what can happen next.

## S4 — Workcell: situated existence — MEF pair L4 Phenomenological × L1′ Phenomenal · movement M41 · parent S

S4 · ARGUED · M41

Workcell is situated existence: the concrete here in which a Life finds itself, encounters resistance, becomes available to others and makes activity materially consequential. Situation is not an accessory added to an otherwise complete subject. A Life is already somewhere: embodied, temporal, exposed to conditions it did not wholly choose, enabled by some relations and constrained by others.

## S5 — Quaternal Logic: Transcendent Relation — MEF pair L5 Para Vāk × L0′ Archetypal-Numerical · movement M42 · parent S

S5 · ARGUED · M42

Quaternal Logic is Transcendent Relation: the movement through which a whole differentiates without ceasing to be whole, and through which differentiated beings remain related to the larger fields in which their distinctions arise. Transcendence here does not require a final exterior standing over the relation.

props.text:
## The Slash — / = −/−

SYMBOLON ROOT · symbolon-the-slash · DERIVED

A dash appears twice, with a stroke between its placements: `−/−`. Neither mark has yet been assigned a value; the slash already makes two placements readable together — the activity through which the same can differ from itself, relation before named terms.
Arithmetic reads the stroke as division and ratio; QL reads it as AND/OR. Opposite signs give direction: `(-1)/(+1)`. Addition cancels, `(-1)+(+1)=0`; subtraction appropriates the span, `(-1)-(+1)=-2`, `(+1)-(-1)=+2`. The polar slash has done neither. Read upon itself, `(0/1)/(1/0)`, it yields `2 + 2² = 4 + 2 = 6`.
Returns-to: Movement 19, and Symbolon — the whole relation whose first stroke is followed here.
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/the-slash.md

## 0/1 — the first orientation — the singular One through the polyvalent All

SYMBOLON ROOT · symbolon-0-1 · DERIVED

`0/1` holds the conscious circumstance in its first orientation: the singular One becomes articulate through the polyvalent All. `0` names unobjectifiable awareness; `1` names appearing, the field of determinate differences; the slash carries the differentiating activity. `1` depends on `0` for being present at all; `0` depends on `1` for manifestation and knowability — an order that cannot be exchanged.
The pair opens its own binary: `00`, `01`, `10`, `11` — `2 + 2² = 2 + 4 = 6`, the first explicit `4+2`. The pairings do not replace the singles.
The seam stays exact: ordinary arithmetic evaluates `0/1` as zero and leaves `1/0` undefined; QL's equality `0/1 = 1/0` concerns the identity of the relation under reversed orientation.
Returns-to: The Loan Returns (§1 · #5→0).
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/0-1.md

## ?/! — inquiry and naming in one sign

SYMBOLON ROOT · symbolon-question-assertion · DERIVED

`?` names openness to determination; `!` names the act of asserting enough for a determination to stand. The slash holds them in one operation: the question has asserted a provisional this, and the assertion carries the question whether it has said truly. “What allows for an essence is essentially inessential.”
The Catuṣkoṭi crossing tests the proposition 0 is and/or is not equal to 1: IS — the appearing belongs to awareness; IS-NOT — awareness is not exhausted by the phenomenon; BOTH holds the two operations; NEITHER turns the account on its own remaining claim. SILENCE names the recognition through which the four corners become one lived movement.
The determination sits at #1; the same sign reappears at processual #3, where `1/0` meets incomputability. The placements are not exchanged.
Returns-to: A18 and §3 · #0.
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/question-assertion.md

## −/+ — withdrawal and extension, reserve and issue

SYMBOLON ROOT · symbolon-minus-plus · DERIVED

Negation's self-relation makes affirmation available: the appearing face belongs to the reserve that issues it. “The void voids itself” — determination arises through the unmarked's own self-limitation. Breathing gives the relation its bodily performance: gathering and release differ, and their difference sustains one living movement. The journey is the issuing pole; residence is the reserve through which issuing can continue.
Signed, the polarity keeps its axis: `(-1)/(+1)`. Addition cancels the contributions, `(-1)+(+1)=0`; subtraction measures the span from one chosen pole, `(-1)-(+1)=-2`, `(+1)-(-1)=+2`. Neither operation can simply be substituted for the living polarity.
Within the sixfold this is #2, Dynamis, paired with `X/x` as the Becoming harmonic and the Text–Texture fold.
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/minus-plus.md

## X/x — one letter in two cases

SYMBOLON ROOT · symbolon-x-x · DERIVED

X names determining capacity; x names its indefinite particular. The same letter carries both; the slash is the activity of determination between them. The small x also carries multiplication in the authored sign: an instance can recur, compound, and generate further instances — entity and operation meet in one mark.
The spine fixes `X/x` at #3, Pattern: “Sojourning through time yet unmovingly presidential.” The small x is the temporal sojourn; X presides as the capacity made legible through that journey. In the psyche register the spine reads X = x: the Self's determining fullness and the ego's particular measurement, related through identity-as-difference. The agentic corollary is an Argued functional crosswalk, with no inference from functional recursion to phenomenal subjectivity.
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/X-x.md

## AM/IS — the personed copula — the slash as second person

SYMBOLON ROOT · symbolon-am-is · DERIVED

AM speaks first-person presence: I am. IS makes something available for third-person predication: it is. The slash carries the second-person relation: an address can be answered; what appears as an object of my account can speak back and alter the account's terms. “I am here” and “she is here” can concern the same person without performing the same act.
The native knower–means–known coordination makes the three offices precise: pramātṛ the knower, pramāṇa the means, prameya the known. The 1–2–3 pass is followed by the 4–5–0 recognition pass — read as 3:3 and 3:1. The determination occupies #4, Context: “Context total yet totally incidental.”
With `∞/dx` this is the Knowing/unKnowing harmonic: someone knows, and the truth of that knowing includes its continuing relation to what exceeds its account.
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/AM-IS.md

## ∞/dx — the horizon no finite mark contains

SYMBOLON ROOT · symbolon-infinity-dx · DERIVED

∞ names the unbounded depth no finite mark contains; dx names the local differential through which change becomes exact. The slash holds local precision in relation to inexhaustible depth; no ordinary quotient of an infinite scalar by an infinitesimal is being calculated.
The calculus development makes the limit exact: `F(x)=x²+7` differentiates to `F'(x)=2x`; integrating restores a family, `∫2x dx = x²+C` — the local change does not select the original `7`. Knowing a determination truly does not entail knowing every condition of its derivation.
At #5, Realisation, the mark faces what it cannot possess: “Silent but in structure reverential.” Across the sequence `∞/dx` joins `0/1` as the Essence fold, 0+5 — one openness encountered before and after determination. The music register declares the same law in another exact form — octave return through the retained `9/8`; different objects, one relation: return retaining a difference.
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/infinity-dx.md

## 1/0 — the obverse orientation — determination returns through its ground

SYMBOLON ROOT · symbolon-1-0 · DERIVED

The parent `/ = −/−` precedes the six determinations `0/1`, `?/!`, `−/+`, `X/x`, `AM/IS`, `∞/dx`; `1/0` turns their achieved articulation back toward its condition, bracketing the sixfold at its returning end. A seventh interior position would turn the return into one more item to be counted.
QL writes the relational identity `0/1 = 1/0` — one relation read from its two ends. The arithmetic seam belongs to the notation's work: `0/1` evaluates to zero, `1/0` is undefined; the returning mark cannot supply a value that would place its condition among its objects.
This is the consequent essence, `5→0`, with 5 implicated in 1 through exactly this connection. Recognition changes the act: the three persons unfold, their isolation is voided, their unity recognised, and that one returns as `0/1`.
Returns-to: A36, Advent of Integral Zero.
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/1-0.md

## Mono/Poly — one through the many — Self-Identity becoming Self-Difference

SYMBOLON HEAD · symbolon-mono-poly · ARGUED

Mono names the singular One; Poly names the All through which that One appears: `0 = One = Self-Identity`, `1 = All = Self-Difference`. The whole is structurally prior to its parts because no part creates the conditions through which it becomes that part — a priority of the relation, not a time before distribution. Inclusion and generation are different predications; both can hold without installing a final owner of the picture.
Monoisation names the reversal of office: a local determination presents itself as the source of the field through which it arose — the promotion of the local `1` into the `0`-office. Two monocultures can occupy the place of plurality while the operation maintaining them stays similar. Recovery returns each claim to the relations it has excluded; a false claim can remain false.
Claim status: Argued — from the authorial QL derivation and the named developmental corpus.
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/mono-poly.md

## Complexio oppositorum — the holding of opposites, carried by the # mark

SYMBOLON HEAD · symbolon-complexio-oppositorum · DERIVED

The native sign `#` names the whole determining relation that can be followed through every station; it does different work from any particular `#0` or `#5`, which locate a determination. The formless takes form; the form recognises the formless through which it appears — inverse directions held in one act.
Held polarity `(-1)/(+1)` keeps zero as common axis; cancellation `(-1)+(+1)=0` ends the opposition; fusion erases the difference through which either term could answer the other. The copula gives the holding its exact form: `/ = ( = =/≠ ≠ )` — and the recount `4+2 → (3+1)+2` survives the change of apprehension.
Two complete units unfold under `#`: the Name (Truth, Mind, Word, Logos, Son, Image) and Power (Play, Need, Sacrifice, Decision, Love, Work). Wholeness keeps its power to differ: the settlement can receive what it excluded without being erased.
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/complexio-oppositorum.md

## Self-Identity — identity as an active relation — to, for, as, with

SYMBOLON HEAD · symbolon-self-identity · DERIVED

To write `A = A` requires two appearances of A and the relation identifying them: sameness is available through difference. Four modalities build: identical to itself (reflexivity), for itself (self-gift), as itself (the one appears as many), with itself (accompaniment through the distinctions). Their priority is constitutive, not temporal.
Two parallel strokes write `=`; crossing them with `/` writes `≠` — difference as equality under cut. The expanded expression `/ = ( = =/≠ ≠ )` holds identity, identity-related-to-difference, and difference in one readable movement. Retaining the two and opening the four pairings `(0,0) (0,1) (1,0) (1,1)` gives `2 + 2² = 6 = 4+2`.
Manifestation differentiates; recognition — the inversion of inversion — knows that differentiation as the source's own activity. The achieved expression does not have to disappear.
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/self-identity.md

## Subject-Logics — the Ø traversal — 0 → Ø → X → Ø/X → (0/Ø)/(1/X) → 1, returning as 0/1

SYMBOLON HEAD · symbolon-subject-logics · DERIVED

`0` names the unobjectifiable subject-pole: C01 defines the subject as defined-indefinable. The inner instrument — antaḥkaraṇa — organises experience; occlusion `Ø` occurs when that describable apparatus is taken as the final knower: the slash fused into the zero, computation confused for the computer. `X` marks the field of crossings; `Ø/X` exposes mediation; `(0/Ø)/(1/X)` holds both sides under recognition; `1` affirms the subject's relation to its world as one being, returning as `0/1`.
Pramātṛ, pramāṇa, prameya give the page three exact offices: numerator, slash, denominator. Descartes and Hume sit at the occlusion as authorial diagnostic placements. In von Neumann's construction `0 = ∅`, `1 = {∅}` — a formal neighbour for a mark that links without becoming identical to what it links.
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/subject-logics.md

## Eight Determinations — (4+2)+2 — one relation, threshold to return

SPINE-INDEX · symbolon-eight-determinations · DERIVED · THE TWELVEFOLD

The eight determinations traverse the inner nature of `0/1`: the parent relation, the sixfold's qualitative body, and the return. The two thresholds bracket the six positions; they add no interior positions. Centre: the `0/1` threshold. Cardinal stations: `?/!` N, `−/+` E, `X/x` S, `AM/IS` W. The ring is the whole, parā, carrying the #0/#5 envelope: `∞/dx` at the rim, `−/−` entering above, `1/0` returning below.
The four heads read this spine — Mono/Poly, `#`, `A=A`, `Ø` — the four scenes just walked. Eight plus four: the twelvefold. This index adds no thirteenth determination.
Folds: Being `0/1·?/!`; Becoming `−/+·X/x`; Knowing/unKnowing `AM/IS·∞/dx`; Essence #0+#5; Constitution #1+#4; Text–Texture #2+#3.
Returns-to: §3 · #0 (Movement 25) and A18.
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/eight-determinations.md

props.text:
## The whole form of The Return of Zero — 0/1 — and the mark returns as 1/0

SYMBOLON · REGISTER PARĀ · symbolon-root · DERIVED

Symbolon is the whole form of The Return of Zero. Its root relation is `0/1`: the non-objectifiable ground and the determinate mark held through the slash that differentiates them. Read in the obverse direction, `1/0`, the mark returns toward the condition it cannot possess. The equality `0/1 = 1/0` names the two orientations of one relation.

props.title: Ares, Aphrodite, Harmonia, Eros, Hephaestus and Poseidon — the whole relation
props.text:
## The song, the bed, and the gods at the door

Demodocus takes up his lyre among the Phaeacians; Odysseus has watched the dancers' feet. The song turns to Ares and Aphrodite, who met secretly in the house of Hephaestus. Helios saw the lovers and carried the news to the husband — and watched again, later, when the unseen work had closed.

## Bonds beyond the gods' sight

In pain and anger Hephaestus sets his anvil and makes bonds that could neither be broken nor loosened by those they held — around the bedposts, suspended from the beams, fine as a spider's web, beyond the gods' sight. He pretends to leave for Lemnos. Ares, watching, sees the husband gone, takes Aphrodite's hand, and the unseen work closes. They can neither lift nor move their limbs; only then do they know escape is impossible. Helios brings word a second time, and grief becomes a summons to Zeus and the gods.

## The children belong to their own tellings

Hesiod's Theogony bears Deimos and Phobos — terror and fear — and Harmonia, whom Cadmus marries; her line continues into a human household. Eros belongs among the primordial powers at 116–122, and accompanies Aphrodite's sea-birth at 176–206; a separately reported lyric parentage (Simonides, in scholia) makes him child of Ares and Aphrodite, its fragment attribution a citation debt. These tellings bring Harmonia and Eros into the field without adding them to Demodocus' scene: Harmonia supplies the named child and continuing genealogy; Eros supplies a primordial power of attraction and, in the variant, a living issue of difference and desire.

## The difference that can meet — the bow that is also a lyre

## What the apparatus gathers — and where it stalls

## The word that takes on the debt

Poseidon repeatedly asks Hephaestus to free Ares and promises Ares will pay. Hephaestus hears the weakness: the man who can depart can evade the payment — how could he bind Poseidon before the immortals? The answer is a changed undertaking: if Ares flees without paying, Poseidon will pay. This gives Hephaestus an answer to his objection without making Ares' future conduct present to inspection. He judges the undertaking acceptable and uses his skill to undo his work; the same hands which assembled the constraint open it. The lovers spring up.

props.text:
## A jewel is chosen within the net

## Entering the others without leaving this one

To enter all the jewels from here is to discover their presence in this one; in those jewels this one is present again. Reflections contain reflections which contain the first reflection, with no final image at which the relation is exhausted. The interlocutor presses: how can one enter all while remaining here? The reply makes remaining here the condition of entry. And if the many are present within this one, why a net of many jewels? Because the one in its comprehensive aspect includes the many — remove that constitutive participation and the net is not preserved. Each apparent opposition returns to how each is present through the others.

## The ink-dot test

Put an ink dot upon the southwest jewel. The dot appears throughout the reflected field; its many appearances do not require someone to have gone around physically marking every jewel. Begin with another jewel and the relation can be followed from there as well. The mark makes a return inspectable: something done at this definite place becomes present through the others, and the others disclose this place in turn. The expanded sequence is recoverable in the Chinese text, T45 no. 1867, 513a20–513c16; the account is a prose paraphrase, not a newly certified quotation from Cleary's printed edition.

props.title: Pauli's egg dream — spontaneous division, conscious participation and the circle
props.text:
## A physicist meets his concepts in a dream

## Pictures 1–2: the egg laid; the egg divides itself

## Pictures 3–4: the egg in his own hand; division that keeps wholeness

## Pictures 5–6: four eggs become expressions; the conjugate quotient

Picture 5: the four eggs change into four mathematical expressions, printed as two rows each holding a cosine term on the left and a sine term on the right. The duplicated terms preserve the paired arrangement while changing the medium of the scene; the picture does not assign each shell colour to a function, so no such assignment is added. Picture 6: the terms give the quotient with cos(δ/2)+i·sin(δ/2) over cos(δ/2)−i·sin(δ/2) — the cosine the same while the imaginary sine term changes sign; for real δ the denominator has modulus one. The dream's organisation has changed from four displayed terms into a single relation retaining their opposing signs.

## Picture 7: he speaks, and the circle appears

Picture 7: Pauli speaks for the first time in this dream. He identifies the expression with e^{iδ} and names the circle; the formula vanishes and a circle appears. The explanation makes the step explicit: the quotient equals e^{iδ/2} over e^{−iδ/2}, which is e^{iδ} — for a fixed real angle a point on the unit circle; as the angle varies, the circle. The distinction keeps the operation exact while preserving what Pauli recognises. The account reports neither a return of the woman and bird nor a restart of the first picture; the completion has the history of differentiation and conscious action within it.

## Section wager

Differentiation structurally retains a zero, and mathematics supplies exact forms through which absence becomes operative: placeholder, numeral, arithmetic element, empty set, origin, and exceptional boundary. Once zero enters a positional system, the whole field of number changes; once 0 is taken as ∅, one and the natural numbers can be generated from its reiterated marking.

Present burden: establish the history precisely enough to carry the philosophical argument, then derive 0/1 as the minimal generative relation before presenting the two ways that relation can be accounted.
